turns.prompt_text: how can I close out of these Android game apps advertisements
turns.response_html: You usually need to find a small "X" or "Skip Ad" button in a corner after a short countdown (usually 5 to 30 seconds). If you can't close the ad, you can try going offline by enabling Airplane Mode before opening the game, or use a Private DNS setting (like dns.adguard-dns.com) on your Android device to block many in-app ads entirely.
